title: Client/Server:
body:
Following pull request contains server and client implementation.

1. add protobuf
2. add gRPC server/client using mTLS for authentification
3. users may use the client to run jobs, query status, stream output, and stop jobs
4. users may not interact with a job started by another user

title: Library: Public library running arbitrary Linux 64-bit process in isolation with resource limits.
body:
PR contains implements for library that running arbitrary Linux 64-bit process in isolation with resource limits. For details, please, follow this RFD Document: https://github.com/P-A-R-U-S/Go-Job-Worker-Service/blob/library/docs/RFD-JobWorkerService.md

To run test you can use following make command:

* `make run_test_cgroup` - run sunset of tests for cgroups
* `make run_test_output` - run subset of test for OutputReader and all related to Steam command output
* `make run_test_job` - run sunset of tests for Job executing (you can check Test Plan section in RFD Document)

_**Note**: because `make run_test_job` need to create and manages crgoup, you possibly need [sudo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sudo) permission to run tests._

Package structure and files name are self-explained, but here is some details: 

```
 |-Makefile (
 |-pkg
 | |-jobWorker
 | | |-namespaces
 | | | |-cgroup.go               --> constains all cgroup functions
 | | | |-cgroup_test.go
 | | | |-mount.go
 | | |-job.go              --> contains all Start/Stop/Stream/Status implementation
 | | |-job_test.go
 | | |-outputReadCloser.go      --> implements io.ReadCloser interface to read from the provided CommandOutput
 | | |-outputReadCloser_test.go
 | | |-commandOutput.go               --> implements io.Closer and io.Writer and implement a command buffer
 | | |-commandOutput_test.go
```

title: Request-For-Discussion 0001: Design Document for Job Worker Service (Valentyn Ponomarenko)
body:
Please, find RFD _(based on template https://github.com/gravitational/teleport/blob/master/rfd/0000-rfds.md)_
Document contains design and implementation details for Job Worker Service.

Document contains following sections:

```
* What
* Why
* Details
   Assumptions
   Not supported (Out of scope)
   Resource limitation
   Primitives and functions considered to be used in library package.
* API
    Primitives and functions considered to be used for API Server.
    Security
    Authorization
    Proposed Protobuf
* Client/CLI 
* Test Plan
   Positive use cases 
   Negative use cases
```

Please, paid attentions to Details, Library and Test Plan section. API and Client mostly mimic base library functionality.
